title: Verbal Prefixes 3: до- (until, up to, finish)
titleRussian: Глагольные приставки 3: до- (до, вплоть до, завершить)
description: The prefix до- adds 'finish what was started' or 'reach a goal / limit.' Дочитать = read to the end. Дойти = walk all the way to. Договориться = come to an agreement. The pattern is everywhere in B1 reading.
descriptionRussian: Приставка до- добавляет значение «довести до конца» или «дойти до предела». Дочитать = прочитать до конца. Дойти = дойти до места. Договориться = прийти к согласию. Эта схема встречается в текстах уровня В1 на каждом шагу.
intro: This one has a single meaning, which makes it the easiest in the book: carrying something already under way to its end point. The distinction worth holding on to is against the plain perfective. Reading a book through frames the whole thing start to finish; finishing a book frames only the last stretch of a job you had already begun.
rules: Finish what was started: до- + base verb → 'carry an in-progress activity all the way to its endpoint.' Дочитать, дописать, доделать, доехать, дойти.
The reflexive договориться means 'come to an agreement'; it pairs with о + the prepositional case for the topic: договориться о встрече.
The до + genitive phrase often names the endpoint explicitly: дойти до парка, дочитать до конца, доехать до Москвы.
До- + an imperfective verb gives a perfective verb, and the stress usually stays on the root, not on до-: дочита́ть, доде́лать.
До- targets the finishing moment of an activity already under way; прочитать, by contrast, frames a whole start-to-finish reading as one fresh event.
examples: Я дочитал роман к утру. (I (m) finished reading the novel by morning.) Finished a reading already in progress.
Маша дописала статью к концу недели. (Masha finished writing the article by the end of the week.) Finish what was started, with a deadline.
Антон доделал отчёт и сдал его шефу. (Anton finished the report and submitted it to the boss.) Finish what was started, then handover.
Дети дошли до парка пешком за двадцать минут. (The children walked all the way to the park in twenty minutes.) До + gen endpoint phrase.
Маша и Антон договорились о встрече в субботу. (Masha and Anton agreed on a meeting on Saturday.) Reflexive договориться + о + prep.
Я допил кофе и пошёл на работу. (I (m) drank up my coffee and went to work.) Finish what was in the cup.

items.prompt: Лена _____ свою презентацию, потому что нашла ошибки. (warm-up from Lesson 2)
items.promptEnglish: Lena redid her presentation because she found mistakes.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 2: shade 2 of пере- (redo). Which prefix?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 2: the 'found mistakes → did from scratch' framing signals пере- + делать → переделала. Today's lesson focuses on the next prefix, до-, which marks 'finish what was started' rather than 'redo from scratch.'

items.prompt: Я _____ роман к утру и лёг спать.
items.promptEnglish: I (m) finished reading the novel by morning and went to bed.
items.hint: Already reading + reached the end by a deadline. Which prefix marks 'finish what was started'?
items.explanation: The 'к утру' deadline plus the 'lying down to sleep' sequence signals that the reading was already in progress and reached its endpoint by morning. До- + читать → дочитал is the canonical 'finish what was started' form. Прочитал would frame the whole start-to-finish reading as a single event without the in-progress framing.

items.prompt: Маша _____ до дома только в девять часов вечера.
items.promptEnglish: Masha reached home only at nine in the evening.
items.hint: До + gen 'до дома' marks the endpoint. Which prefix?
items.explanation: The до + gen prepositional phrase 'до дома' pairs naturally with the до- prefix: до- + ехать → доехала. Past fem of доехать. Past pf приехала ('arrived') would work in some contexts but does not pair as naturally with до + gen; ехала is the impf process; поехала is the onset of motion.

items.prompt: Маша и Антон _____ о встрече в субботу.
items.promptEnglish: Masha and Anton agreed on a meeting on Saturday.
items.hint: Agreement on a specific arrangement. Which до- verb?
items.explanation: Reaching an agreement on a meeting signals the reflexive договориться → past pl договорились. The о + prep phrase 'о встрече' is the standard pairing. Говорили (impf) is ongoing talking; сказали (pf of сказать) is one-time saying; поговорили means 'had a conversation' but does not entail reaching an agreement.

items.prompt: Дети _____ до парка пешком за двадцать минут.
items.promptEnglish: The children walked all the way to the park in twenty minutes.
items.hint: До + gen 'до парка' marks the endpoint on foot. Which prefix?
items.explanation: The 'до + gen' phrase plus 'пешком' (on foot) and a bounded time signals reaching the endpoint of the walk: до- + идти → дошли. Past pl pf. Пошли = onset of motion (set off, without 'all the way to'); ходили = round-trip; шли = motion in progress.

items.prompt: Антон _____ кофе и пошёл на работу.
items.promptEnglish: Anton drank up the coffee and went to work.
items.hint: Drank to the last drop and moved on. Which prefix marks 'finish what's in the cup'?
items.explanation: 'Finish drinking what's in the cup' is the до- shade. Past masc pf of допить → допил. Выпил would frame 'drank one cup completely' (also valid but with a different emphasis); пил is the impf process; пьёт is the present.

blanks: Антон _____ статью к концу недели. (Anton finished writing the article by the end of the week.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: The 'к концу недели' deadline plus an implied in-progress writing signals до- + писать → дописал ('finish writing what was in progress'). Past masc pf. Написал would frame the whole write-from-scratch as a single event; писал is the impf process; переписал means 'rewrite, copy out.'

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша начала роман в отпуске и только вчера прочитала его до конца.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha started the novel on vacation and only yesterday finished it.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Начала ...Только вчера [reached the end]' frames a reading that was in progress and is now finished, the до- shade: дочитала. The до + gen 'до конца' pairs naturally with до-. Прочитала frames the whole reading as one fresh event, double-counting the 'начала в отпуске' already stated. Перечитала means 'reread', записала 'wrote down'.

errorCorrection.sentence: После долгой дороги мы приехали до дачи только к вечеру.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: After a long drive, we reached the dacha only by evening.
errorCorrection.explanation: The 'до + gen' endpoint phrase 'до дачи' pairs with the до- prefix: доехали до дачи (made it all the way). Приехали (arrived) takes a bare destination without до ('приехали на дачу'), so 'приехали до дачи' mixes two frames.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон делал проект всю неделю и вчера наконец переделал его до конца.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton worked on the project all week and yesterday finally finished it.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Наконец ... до конца' signals carrying an unfinished job through to its end, the до- shade: доделал. Переделал means 'redid it', which wrongly implies a second version; the context describes finishing the first one.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha reached Moscow only in the morning.
minimalPairs.explanation: The до + gen endpoint 'до Москвы' plus 'only in the morning' (signalling the arrival moment) pulls до- + ехать → доехала. Поехала would be the onset of motion (set off for Moscow), which 'утром' as the arrival time contradicts.

minimalPairs.context: Антон _____ отчёт и сдал его начальнику.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton finished the report and submitted it to the boss.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'And submitted it' signals reaching the endpoint of an in-progress task: до- + делать → доделал. Переделал would mean 'redid from scratch' (with no mistakes-trigger here to motivate a redo).

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each verb by its до- meaning.

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix до- (turns the verb perfective and adds 'reach the endpoint of an in-progress activity'; often paired with до + gen phrase that names the endpoint)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Я дочитал роман к утру' приставка до- маркирует завершение начатого чтения.

reviewVocab.definition: to bring through to the end (the canonical paraphrase of the до- shade; finish what was started)
reviewVocab.example: Глагол «дочитать» значит «довести чтение до конца»: действие уже шло, и говорящий достиг его финальной точки.

reviewVocab.definition: to agree on (reflexive verb formed with до-; metaphorical 'talk all the way to a shared endpoint'; pairs with о + prep for the topic)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша и Антон договорились о встрече' конструкция «договориться о + предложный» вводит предмет соглашения.
